title: Cooling Budgets & Heat Pumps: A Field Guide
text: Cooling Budgets & Heat Pumps: A Field Guide Home Guides About us Cooling Budgets & Heat Pumps Priya Raman · 12 March 2026 A heat pump moves heat; it does not make it. That is why a unit rated at 3 kW of electrical input can deliver 9 kW of cooling — a coefficient of performance of 3. What the numbers mean COP < 2: replace it. COP between 2 and 4: typical. COP > 4: excellent, check the test conditions. Budget line: <cooling> = rated_kW × hours × tariff . For a 9 kW unit at 6 hours a day and ₹8 per kWh, that is about ₹1,440 a day. COP falls as the outdoor temperature rises. “Size for the hottest week, not the average one.” Questions? Write to guides@example.com . We answer within a week. © 2026 Example Guides.
